1 Tablespoon Butter to Grams Converter

Convert US tablespoons of butter into grams — accurate for salted, unsalted, and European-style butter.

Gram Equivalent:

14.2 grams (14.2 g)

*1 cup unsalted butter = 227g, 1 tbsp = 1/16 cup = 14.2g. Salted ≈ 14.3g/tbsp, European-style ≈ 14.1g/tbsp.

How Many Grams in 1 Tablespoon of Butter?

1 US tablespoon of unsalted butter equals 14.2 grams — but the number shifts subtly depending on butter type. Standard US unsalted butter: 1 cup = 227 g ÷ 16 tbsp = 14.2 g/tbsp. Salted butter, which contains ~1.5–2% salt by weight, clocks slightly denser at ~14.3 g/tbsp (229 g/cup). European-style butter at 82%+ butterfat is fractionally less dense at ~14.1 g/tbsp (225 g/cup). For most home baking these differences are academic — but if you're scaling a commercial recipe 50×, 0.1 g per tablespoon compounds to a measurable error.

The Conversion Formula (Tbsp → Grams)

The math is straightforward:

  • Grams = Tablespoons × (Grams-per-Cup ÷ 16)
  • Butter: 1 tbsp × (227 ÷ 16) = 14.2 grams
  • 2 tbsp butter = 28.4 grams
  • 4 tbsp butter = 56.8 grams (1/4 cup, or half a stick)
  • 8 tbsp butter = 113.5 grams (1/2 cup, or 1 stick)

Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: How many grams is 1 tablespoon of butter?

A1: One US tablespoon of butter weighs approximately 14.2 grams. This is based on the standard density of 227g per US cup ÷ 16 tablespoons per cup.

Q2: Does salted vs unsalted butter weigh differently per tablespoon?

A2: Yes — salted butter is about 0.1 g heavier per tablespoon (14.3 vs 14.2 g) due to ~1.5–2% salt content. European-style butter at 82%+ butterfat is slightly lighter (~14.1 g/tbsp). The difference is negligible for home baking but matters at commercial scale — use the dropdown above to switch types.

Q3: Why measure butter in grams if US sticks have tablespoon markings?

A3: US butter sticks are convenient for tablespoons, but if you're using block butter, scaling a recipe, or working with European-style butter, grams eliminate guesswork. Also helpful when a recipe lists butter in grams and you only have marked sticks.
